description: This Python source file defines a cost calculation function for a Lemonade LLM provider, which is self-hosted and incurs no costs. It includes a function `cost_per_token` that always returns zero costs for prompt and completion tokens, to facilitate cost tracking without errors regardless of model configuration.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_token( model: str, usage: Usage, )
methods.description: Calculates and returns zero cost per token (prompt and completion) for a Lemonade model, since Lemonade is self-hosted and doesn't incur token costs.
